235: // checkNetmapConfExists checks if the network mapper configuration file exists.
236: // If not, if attempts to generate the file using generateNetmapConfig.
237: func checkNetmapConfExists() (NetworkNameMapper, error) {
238: 	pathNetmap := workstationNetmapConfPath()
239: 
240: 	// If the default network mapper configuration file exists, read it.
241: 	if _, err := os.Stat(pathNetmap); err == nil {
242: 		log.Printf("Located the network mapper configuration file: %s", pathNetmap)
243: 		return ReadNetmapConfig(pathNetmap)
244: 	} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
245: 		// An error other than the file not existing occurred.
246: 		return nil, err
247: 	}
248: 
249: 	log.Printf("A network mapper configuration file does not exist in the default path: %s", pathNetmap)
250: 
251: 	// The default file does not exist, check the alternate configuration path.
252: 	libpath, _ := workstationVMwareRoot()
253: 	pathNetworking := filepath.Join(libpath, "networking")
254: 	log.Printf("Checking alternate path for network mapper configuration file: %s", pathNetworking)
255: 	if _, err := os.Stat(pathNetworking); err == nil {
256: 		// Alternate networking configuration path exists. Using this path.
257: 		log.Printf("Located the network mapper configuration file: %s", pathNetworking)
258: 		fd, err := os.Open(pathNetworking)
259: 		if err != nil {
260: 			return nil, err
261: 		}
262: 		defer fd.Close()
263: 
264: 		// Then we pass the handle to the networking configuration parser.
265: 		return ReadNetworkingConfig(fd)
266: 	}
